scope: Pinned relevant native and original companion controller code only; code reads, not historical execution. This bounded inventory does not claim to cover every branch ancestor.

Runtime risk/post-fill checks already read account.config caps, no new financial formulas needed.
advance_day hardcodes .30 asset/.60 gross; requires reviewed separate native adapter.
account_for_cost returns original scenario config through factory; needs explicit H090 binding.
risk reductions already read account.config caps; unchanged reduce-first, own-ledger and capacity logic must be preserved.
signed_risk_weights hardcodes .60 gross/.10 maximum vol; higher-risk intent controller is separate, not an edit here.
fixed_targets additionally has .10 vol and .60 sizing; do not silently scale account NAV or relabel caps.
scenario_config/account_for_cost instantiate original PerpetualConfig, including original .60 risk default. Cost math must stay unchanged while H090 config binding is explicit.
Frozen canonical .60/.30/.10 risk fields; only original timing/cost arithmetic reused. New H090 risk descriptor required; this object is not high-risk certification.

additional_companion_gates.gate: RULES baseline metadata: annual_vol_target=.10, asset_abs_cap=.3, gross_cap=.6; sizing_buffer=.99, leverage1 and original funding-then-reductions-then-increases order. A future native H090 descriptor must not reuse this .60/.10 identity.

ANNUAL_BUDGET=.10, ASSET_CAP=.30, GROSS_CAP=.60; input caps, desired/cap factors and post-sigma proofs all depend on these constants. The H090 shrink-only toy is not a reviewed replacement for this risk-matching allocator.

directional and market_neutral default gross=.6; market_neutral asserts .60 gross and .30 assets. More exposure requires a separately reviewed intent recipe, with original expert/direction logic preserved.
Compatibility signed_risk_weights retains <=.10 vol, .60 gross scaling and .30 clipping.
CS target controller declares annual_vol_target=.10 and passes .10 explicitly to signed_risk_weights for held and kept assets.

SMA input sizing uses .6/K, calls baseline signed_risk_weights, and validates every original arm at .30 assets/.60 gross. EXACTHALF stays a .5/.5 original mix; changing these guards is not authorized by a vendor config change.
RULES baseline annual budget .10, asset cap .30, gross cap .60 and original continuous-economics execution metadata remain separate from H090.
